We also must avoid "e.g.," which includes a comma after e.g. So we must avoid that. Use "for example" instead.

We also must avoid "i.e.,". Use "that is".

We must avoid listing with commas: "apples, oranges, bananas". So we need to avoid that.

Subject: Invitation to Strategy Planning Meeting

Dear Team

I hope you are all doing well and are ready to engage in an important discussion about our upcoming projects.

The purpose of this meeting is to review progress on current initiatives identify any challenges and define clear next steps that will keep us aligned with our strategic goals.

We have scheduled the meeting for Thursday November 6 2025 at 10:00 AM in the main conference room and also via video link for remote participants.

Please join the session a few minutes early to test your audio and video connections.

During the meeting we will share updates from each department discuss how our efforts are correlated with the overall company objectives and explore ways to improve collaboration across teams.

We will also look at any risks that teams are experiencing and brainstorm solutions that can mitigate those issues before they impact delivery timelines.

An agenda is outlined below to help you prepare.

Agenda
1 Welcome and objectives
2 Departmental progress reports
3 Correlation analysis of project outcomes with company targets
4 Identification of challenges teams are experiencing
5 Development of action plans and responsibility assignments
6 Q and A and closing remarks

We encourage you to come prepared with any data or insights that you think will be useful for the discussion.

If you have any topics you would like to add to the agenda please send them to me by end of day Tuesday.

Kindly confirm your attendance by replying to this email no later than Wednesday morning.

Thank you for your commitment and we look forward to a productive session.

Best regards
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Contact Information]
